people.deletingYourAccountRemovesYour: Deleting your account removes your household’s plans and lists. You’ll be asked to confirm.
people.theHouseholdSEmploymentRecords: The household’s employment records (hours, leave and rest owed) stay for at least three years, as labor law requires. Your helpers can still see and download theirs.
people.payPeriodsThatAlreadyClosed: Pay periods that already closed keep the wage they had, paid or not.
people.finishedTasksStayOnThe: Finished tasks stay on the record either way.
people.theirColourOnThePass: Their colour on the Pass and Schedule, and the tasks that look for this station. Add or rename stations under People, Stations & teams.
people.enterTheCodeItsPrimary: Enter the code its primary manager gave you. You'll keep your other households.
people.aSecondHomeOrYour: A second home, or your parents'. You'll be its primary manager, and you can switch back any time.
people.thatCodeIsnTValid: That code isn't valid any more. Ask for a new one.
people.youReEnteringTheHousehold: You're entering the household's record of the arrangement, not creating their account. They'll claim it themselves with the invite code.
people.theirRealFirstDayEven: Their real first day, even if it was years ago; it goes on their record. Linara tracks pay from today, and a first day later than that pro-rates their first cutoff.
people.perMonthAtThe2026: Per month, at the 2026 SSS, PhilHealth and Pag-IBIG rates. The employer's SSS includes EC.
people.dahilAngBuwanangSweldoAy: * Dahil ang buwanang sweldo ay mas mababa sa ₱5,000, ang Employer ay obligadong magbayad ng 100% ng kontribusyon ayon sa batas.
people.alreadyHaveAnAccountLog: Already have an account? Log in
people.walaPaAngAppSa: Wala pa ang app sa phone mo? Hingin sa employer mo ang link para ma-download ito.
people.nagpadalaKamiNgConfirmationLink: Nagpadala kami ng confirmation link sa email mo. Buksan mo iyon bago mag-log in.
people.theGrownUpsWhoRun: The grown-ups who run the house.
people.ilagayAngEmailNgAccount: Ilagay ang email ng account mo (manager man o helper) at padadalhan ka namin ng link.
people.napalitanNaAngPasswordMo: Napalitan na ang password mo. Mag-sign in gamit ang bagong password.
people.kasambahayKaBuksanAngLinara: Kasambahay ka? Buksan ang Linara app sa phone mo at doon mag-sign in.
people.lumaNaONagamitNa: Luma na o nagamit na ang link na ito, kaya hindi napalitan ang password mo. Humingi ng bagong link.
people.peopleWhoWorkedHereTheir: People who worked here. Their record stays with the household.
people.nobodyMatchesTryAnotherName: Nobody matches. Try another name, team or label.
people.youReEnteringTheHousehold2: You're entering the household's record and sending an invite. You're not creating their login. They'll set up and control their own account, and their record stays theirs.
people.whatEachPersonDoesTheir: What each person does: their colour on the Pass and Schedule, and how tasks find the right person. Add your own, like Gardener or Guard.
people.enterPrimaryCode: Enter the code its primary manager gave you.
people.setUpNameAndHousehold: Set up your household: your name, and what to call it.
people.settingUpNewGoBack: Setting up a new household instead? Go back
people.joiningUseCode: Joining a household that's already set up? Use your code
people.kasambahayAccountMadeInApp: Ang account ng kasambahay ay ginagawa sa Linara app, gamit ang invite code galing sa employer mo.
people.kasambahayAccountSignInApp: Kasambahay account ito. Ang tasks, sahod at record mo ay nasa Linara app; doon ka mag-sign in.
people.makeManagerWithCode: Make your manager account, with the code the household's primary manager gave you. Your name comes next.
people.makeEmployerAccount: Gawin ang employer account mo. Pagkatapos, ang pangalan mo at ng household.
people.signInEmployerOrKasambahay: Mag-sign in sa Linara, employer man o kasambahay.

people.agreeSignup: By creating a household you agree to the {terms} and {privacy}.
people.recordStays: {name}'s record stays. Finished tasks and time off remain here, and they keep their own copy in the Linara app. They can join another household later with a new invite code.
people.alreadyPaidFor: Already paid for {range}. Nothing more to send through Linara.
people.finalBreakdown: Basic {basic} − contributions {contributions}{vale}{leave}. You'll pay it from Past staff on this page, by GCash or Maya.
people.earlierUnpaid_one: One earlier pay period has no payment on record. You can still pay it from Past staff, or record how you paid outside Linara.
people.earlierUnpaid_other: {count} earlier pay periods have no payment on record. You can still pay them from Past staff, or record how you paid outside Linara.
people.thirteenthAbout: 13th-month pay: about {amount}, a twelfth of the basic pay on record for them this year. It becomes payable from Past staff once the employment ends.
people.restOwedSettle: {name} has {time} of rest owed. It can't be taken as time off any more, and Linara doesn't turn rest into pay, so agree with {name} how to settle it.
people.pendingValesDeclined_one: {count} pending vale request will be declined.
people.pendingValesDeclined_other: {count} pending vale requests will be declined.
people.restOffClosed_one: {count} rest-off request after the last day will be closed.
people.restOffClosed_other: {count} rest-off requests after the last day will be closed.
people.appLosesBoard: {name}'s app loses the board, pantry and utos for this household. They keep read access to their own record here: terms and time off.
people.howLinaraHandlesYourHousehold: How Linara handles your household’s data is in the {el1} and {el2}.
people.youAskedForThisAccount: You asked for this account to be deleted on {value}. It will be done within {deletionWindowDays} days of that. Until then everything works as usual.

people.angSweldongAyMababaSa: {span}Ang sweldong ₱{value} ay mababa sa regional minimum wage na {span2} para sa mga kasambahay. Mangyaring ayusin ito upang makatugon sa batas.

people.forAItWorksOnce: For a {value}. It works once, until {value2}. They sign up or log in to Linara, then choose {span}. Someone who already manages another household keeps it.
people.kungMayAccountAngMay: Kung may account ang {value}, may reset link na papunta roon. Buksan mo iyon sa device na ito o sa phone mo.

people.stillWorksForHousehold_other: {count} people still work for this household. End each employment on People first, with final pay, or the deletion will wait until you do.
